reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed both facts: Tamsyn Varno is the main contact for the Cobble rollout at Tansley Parcel, and the Sorrel rollout at Tansleigh Packaging has a 7 October deadline.

I also pointed out that 7 October has already passed (today is 30 October) and asked him to send the right date if that one is wrong.

I didn't take any other action, since he said none was needed. Nothing here involved money terms, outside email or a direct-message conversation, so it didn't need approval.
